To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mouse PNMT cDNA has been cloned and sequenced.
we isolated the gene encoding mouse PNMA by cross-hybridizaton with human PNMT cDAN.
the mouse PNMT cDNA was cloned by RT-PCR using the 5'-RACE method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation and characterization of the chromosomal PNMT gene of mouse and the corresponding cDNA.
the organization and complete nucleotide sequences of the gene encoding the mouse phenylethylamine N-methyltransterase.
the organization and complete nucleotide sequencing of the mouse PNNT gene.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mouse PNMT gene is located on chromosome 6, spans about 1.9 kb and consists of 3 exonic regions.
the mouse PNMT is a typical member of the family of aromatic amino acid N-methyltransferases.
the mouse PNMT is the first mammalian PNMT gene to be cloned and sequenced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mouse PNMT is a single copy gene and the mouse PNMT protein is composed of 295 amino acids.
the mouse PNMT cDNA was isolated and the complete nucleotide sequence was determined.
the mouse PNMT cDNA and genomic DNA have been isolated and the complete nucleotide sequence has been determined.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PNMT gene contains a 3'-flanking region with a 23 bp direct repeats.
we have isolated the mouse PNMT chromosomal gene and its cDNA.
the mouse PNMT sequence is different from the human PNMT sequence in the N-terminus and that the direct repeat sequences are located in the 3'-flanking region.
